religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore): Lawful venerates the Lawful powers and names the Chaotic as demons; Chaotic the reverse; Neutral honors ancestral and local powers, invoking the great powers situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Poeshi — domineering imperial hegemony of the synthesis; law, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Poeshi are a vigorous imperial hegemony people, a first-order synthesis of Ellinike and Qinzhao [Peer Synthesis / Hegemonic]. They prize law, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, light_infantry, marines. Outsiders are met as domineering; their patrons touch war.
